name: Cellular, Molecular and Biomedical Sciences PhD

publishedDeadlines.label: Completed application
publishedDeadlines.note: All materials and fee-waiver approval required. Year and timezone not stated; no countdown.

english.toefl: CMB funding: 100 legacy; central GTA: 5 new scale
english.note: Two-year scores; no TOEFL superscoring. US or qualifying English-official-country degree can exempt; foreign institution must confirm English instruction. Other waiver requests reviewed, not automatic. CMB lists these higher thresholds for funding; central general admission is lower.

applicationFee.note: Case-by-case hardship/qualifying-affiliation requests in application; no guarantee. Certain outside-fellowship international applicants explicitly mentioned; confirm eligibility. Allow 48 business hours.

documents: Official or unofficial transcripts from all colleges
Statement of purpose describing research and program fit
requirements.note: US bachelor equivalent expected (16 years education; HND not equivalent). No CMB minimum GPA. Prior faculty contact not expected; three first-year research rotations identify adviser. Strong references describe research contributions, skills and potential. Official records required before matriculation.

funding.note: CMB offers depend on faculty capacity and research/stipend funds; no unconditional package or program-specific amount stated. Central assistantships are open to international full-time students and generally include tuition support. Central 2026–27 minimum $25,781/9 months or $34,375/12 months; confirm actual offer.

timeline.interviews: Online interviews usually late January; admitted visit March.
timeline.decisions: Initial status early February; waitlist offers may continue mid-to-late April.
